Attenuation or gain factor (up to 10 decimals).
• Shunt: resistance in ohm (e.g. 0.1 for a 0.1 ohm shunt)
• Amplifier: gain (e.g. 10.0 for an amplifier x10)
• Default: 1.0 (no attenuation)

channel_range_tip: Auto, or a fixed range. A fixed range is faster and does not change during the measurement.
channel_nplc_tip: Integration time in power line cycles: more cycles give less noise and a slower reading (20 or 100 for a small signal such as a shunt).
channel_zero_tip: Before the measurement the program asks you to short the two terminals of this channel and takes the reading as the offset to subtract, then asks you to connect them back.
channel_impedance_tip: Auto: above 10 GΩ on the lowest ranges (for a high-impedance source). Fixed: 10 MΩ on every range. DC voltage only.
channel_setting_unavailable: The model of this instrument cannot do this, or not for this function.
channel_sensor_tip: Probe and sensor: for a thermocouple its letter (K, J, T...); for an RTD its type (PT385 or PT3916); for a thermistor its resistance at 25 °C. The model lists the sensors it accepts.
inst_problem_sweep_order: The stop frequency must be higher than the start frequency.
inst_problem_sweep_range: The sweep is outside the frequency range of the model ({low} to {high} Hz).
inst_problem_sweep_points: The number of points must be a whole number from 2 to {max}.
inst_problem_sweep_if_bandwidth: The IF bandwidth must be a positive number.
inst_problem_sweep_power: The source power must be a number.

compat_intro_block: This measurement cannot be made with these instruments. Adjust the sweep (or the parameters) so that it stays inside what the instrument can do, shown below next to the previous instrument, or choose another instrument.
